en.headline: i-CABLE shareholders approve rename to CTF Media & Entertainment
en.dek: All voting shareholders backed the change of company name to reflect closer ties with the Chow Tai Fook group; the new identity will not alter consumer brands such as HOY and i-Cable News.
body: Shareholders of i-CABLE Communications Limited on Monday unanimously approved a proposal to change the company’s name to CTF Media & Entertainment Limited in English and 周大福媒體娛樂有限公司 in Chinese.

The company said the new name better reflects its business direction and the synergies available within the Chow Tai Fook group. Consumer-facing brands including HOY and i-Cable News will remain unchanged, while the broadband business will continue to use the i-Cable brand. The parent-company name is intended to support cross-group resources and collaboration.
The change remains subject to formal approval by the Registrar of Companies in Hong Kong. The company will proceed with the necessary filing once the certificate of change of name is issued.

zh.headline: 有線寬頻股東全數通過改名周大福媒體娛樂
zh.dek: 公司表示新名稱更能反映與周大福集團的協同效應，面向觀眾的HOY及有線新聞等品牌將維持不變。
body: 有線寬頻通訊有限公司周一舉行股東大會，獲所有有投票的股東全數通過，將公司名稱更改為「周大福媒體娛樂有限公司」，英文名稱為CTF Media & Entertainment Limited。
公司表示，新名稱更能反映業務發展方向及與周大福集團的協同效應。直接面向觀眾的業務品牌，包括HOY及有線新聞等將不受影響；寬頻業務繼續沿用「有線寬頻」品牌，「周大福媒體娛樂」作為母公司品牌，可為各業務提供更強大資源及跨界合作機會。
改名仍須獲香港公司註冊處處長批准。公司將按程序提交申請，待發出更改名稱證明書後正式採用新名稱。
